_head: Phase 1's measurements, replayable. Boxes are design pt at 3 capture px to the pt; run with --pt 3. `img` is assets/refs/pN.png, the Nth Mobbin capture as it exported: 1179x2676, which is 393x852pt plus the 120px Mobbin footer that sits below every probe here. N is Mobbin's export order, not the board number: the deck leads with the profile pair, so 01 reads p6 and 02 p7, and 03-07 read p1-p5. --against wants scratch/shot, which scratch/run.py fills with the fifteen boards rendered at 3x with --crop-phone; every probe names its own board there. Nothing is probed on the Dynamic Island (x 134-259 y 11-47), the home indicator (x 127-266 y 839-846) or the 52pt display corners -- those three are this repo's frame and the capture carries none of them. Every probe replays a run both sides draw. Nine left the file when 02 took @Yilin0x's own timeline: chip, chip-ink, m-card, m-play and t-space read the Spaces card no board draws now, t-name and t-meta the demo persona's name and location, and nav-l and nav-r the purple X tints the nav bar with while a Space is live, which that timeline no longer has -- and a run the bio's second line pushes down cannot be probed anyway, since one box is read on both images. Those nine measurements stay on the 00b-00f evidence boards, which quote the capture and are not replayed against a render. spaces is not among them: 13's card brought it back, on a screen this time.
